title: 第7章 安怜！你竟然勾搭上了叶闻白！
novel_title: 贵族学院平民盲女怎么成了白月光
content_zh:
她拉长语调，故意停顿了一下。

    安怜有种不好的预感。

    “难不成你暗恋怜怜？”

    安怜：“……”

    她就知道，一个寝室睡不出两种人。

    薛纯这张嘴，真的是什么话都敢往外说。

    安怜默默地低下头，假装自己什么都没听到。

    颜棠愣了一秒，随即像被踩了尾巴的猫一样跳了起来：“你瞎说什么！我怎么会喜欢她！也不看看她……”

    她目光落在安怜身上，上下打量了一番。

    五官精致，皮肤白皙，安安静静坐在那里，确实挺乖挺好看的……

    颜棠猛地甩了甩头，把这个奇怪的想法甩出脑海。

    什么跟什么啊！

    她怎么会觉得安怜好看！

    “你们俩身上的衣服加起来都没有我一只耳环贵！”颜棠指着两人，气急败坏地吼道，“我怎么可能喜欢她！你脑子有病吧薛纯！”

    安怜听到这话，脑子灵光一闪。

    颜棠说得对，她们身上的衣服确实不值钱，但反过来想，颜棠这么有钱，要是她愿意给她们买几件衣服，她变卖了也能赚一点钱啊。

    安怜试探性地开口：“那要不你给我们买两件？也不用太贵，就你耳环那个价位的就行。”

    颜棠：“？”

    她是这个意思吗？

    她明明是在嘲讽她们穷，怎么变成她要掏钱给她们买衣服了？

    “你、你们……”颜棠指着安怜，手指都在发抖，又转头指指薛纯，“你们两个简直不可理喻！”

    她真是气死了。

    明明是想来找茬的，怎么反而被这两个人气得说不出话。

    下一秒，她的一个小跟班急急忙忙地跑过来，举着通讯终端凑到颜棠面前。

    “老大老大，你看这个！”

    颜棠不耐烦地瞥了一眼屏幕，神情蓦然僵住。

    屏幕上是一张照片。

    照片里，叶闻白单手揽着安怜的腰，高大的身躯将她笼罩在怀里，低头凑近她的耳畔，姿态亲昵。
content_en:
She drew out her voice and paused deliberately.

    An Lian had a bad feeling.

    "Is it possible that you have a crush on Lian Lian?"

    An Lian: "..."

    She knew that two kinds of people could not sleep in the same dormitory.

    Xue Chun's mouth really dared to say anything.

    An Lian lowered her head silently, pretending that she didn't hear anything.

    Yan Tang was stunned for a second, and then jumped up like a cat whose tail was stepped on: "What nonsense are you talking about! How could I like her! I don't even look at her..."

    Her eyes fell on An Lian and she looked up and down.

    She has delicate facial features and fair skin. Sitting there quietly, she is really good-looking and well-behaved...

    Yan Tang shook his head violently to get this strange thought out of his mind.

    What are you talking about?

    How could she think An Lian was pretty?

    "The clothes you two are wearing combined are not as expensive as one of my earrings!" Yan Tang pointed at the two of them and shouted angrily, "How could I possibly like her! You are mentally ill, Xue Chun!"

    When An Lian heard this, an idea flashed in his mind.

    Yan Tang was right, the clothes they were wearing were indeed worthless, but on the other hand, if Yan Tang was so rich, if she was willing to buy them some clothes, she could make some money by selling them.

    An Lian tentatively said: "How about you buy two pieces for us? It doesn't have to be too expensive, just the price of your earrings."

    Yan Tang: "?"

    Did she mean it?

    She was obviously mocking them for being poor, so why did she end up spending money to buy them clothes?

    "You, you..." Yan Tang pointed at An Lian, his fingers were trembling, and then turned to point at Xue Chun, "You two are simply unreasonable!"

    She was so angry.

    He obviously wanted to make trouble, but instead he was so angry that he couldn't speak.

    The next second, one of her followers hurried over and approached Yan Tang holding a communication terminal.

    "Boss, boss, look at this!"

    Yan Tang glanced at the screen impatiently, and his expression suddenly froze.

    On the screen is a photo.

    In the photo, Ye Wenbai holds An Lian's waist with one hand, his tall body enveloping her in his arms, and he lowers his head close to her ear in an intimate manner.
title_en: Chapter 7 An Lian! You actually hooked up with Ye Wenbai!
